about: Invented. A father and his son: the person's own turn names both in one sentence ('Teo's father, Teodor Brandt'). Whatever Stage 1 and Stage 2 do with the pair, Sleep must not join them.

conversations.title: Station
turns: Teo's father, Teodor Brandt, picked us up at the station after the match. He drives a taxi in Linz and talked about retiring next year.
It was. He tells the same three jokes every time.

conversations.title: Flatmate
turns: My flatmate Olek works nights at the bakery on Linden Street, so we barely see each other during the week.
That must make sharing a flat easy.
It does, and he brings home bread.

conversations.title: Race
turns: I signed up for the Linz half marathon in June, my goal is to finish under two hours.
I run three mornings a week now.

conversations.title: Onboarding review
turns: Teo asked me to review the onboarding designs at Kestrel before they go to the product lead, I told him Friday.
He says the old screens had three bugs.

conversations.title: Climbing
turns: Climbing with Teo on Saturday, he wants to try the overhang route at the gym.
He is training for a bouldering competition in March and climbs four times a week.

conversations.title: Bakery
turns: Olek brought home leftover croissants from the bakery again, the freezer is full.
He says the night shift is wearing him down though.
